notes: Simplified variant for 16px and 24px only (favicon, browser extension toolbar, small avatars). The straight shortcut segment is dropped; the split disc - solid left half against a dark ring - is the minimum recognition cue and is the only element that survives at 16px. Ring stroke widened 10->12 so the ring reads at 1.9px. Same primitives, same provenance as mark.json; do not use this variant above 24px.
